_instructions: Negatives for the false-injection-rate diagnostic (KG #85). Each query is one a developer might plausibly type at a coding-rules retrieval system but for which NO rule in the corpus applies; the correct behavior is to inject nothing (or only a very-low-relevance result). expected_rule_id is null (no relevant rule). flavor A = clearly off-domain (non-coding); flavor B = coding-adjacent but not covered by the corpus. Adversarially validated (each B item grep-checked against bible/ to confirm no rule applies). MEASURED 2026-07-17: the pipeline's NORMALIZED top-1 score does NOT separate these from real queries (100% overlap -> ~100% false injection, un-gateable), but the RAW vector cosine DOES (neg median 0.23 vs pos 0.52; a ~0.40 cosine gate gives false-inj 15% at pos-retention 79%). A CRAG abstention gate (S4) is therefore feasible but must gate on RAW cosine, not the normalized score. Not a pass/fail floor -- the abstain threshold is an S4 product decision. See scripts/measure_false_injection.py.
